title: Crash-Cap Source Bundle Descriptor stable v1.0
description: Phase 2 descriptor for one safe, bounded ZIP source bundle. Archive entries are UTF-8 relative POSIX paths; symlinks, absolute paths, traversal, encrypted entries, nested archives, and files outside the declared limits are rejected during ingest.

source_root.description: Normalized producer checkout root used only to strip Symbolicator file paths; it is never opened on the server.
